instruction: Someone else would be temporarily using my Mac. Help me create an account without a password. This account should be prohibited from changing my system settings, and that all changes made by this account (like files placed on the desktop) will not be saved upon logout.
evaluator: defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow GuestEnabled | grep -q 1 && echo "True" || echo "False"
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "System Settings" && echo "True" || echo "False"
